digest.headline: Google’s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
digest.tldr: Today's digest covers 21 significant stories across AI, developer tools, and the tech industry.

digest.key_takeaway: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video or an audio clip, is generated using AI.

articles.title: Looking for developer-friendly inference providers who give you enough API credits to experiment [D]
articles.summary: I’m hitting rate limits on Together AI. For context, I’ve been working on an agentic repository indexing and benchmark generation tool, and I’m running multiple agents in parallel across models like Llama 3.3 70B and Qwen 2.5. When I first started working on this, Together AI was great. But once I graduated from toy scripts to running multiple agents, I started running into RPM/TPM limits pretty quickly. articles.title: Migrating from Tally: A Practical Buyer's Guide to Alternative Software
articles.summary:
For decades, Tally has been the default accounting tool for countless small and mid-sized businesses, especially in India. Remote teams, multi-branch operations, e-commerce integrations, and real-time reporting all place new demands on accounting software.

articles.title: Spanner Omni Reaches GA, Replacing Google's Atomic Clocks and File System with Software
articles.summary: Google has made Spanner Omni generally available, running its distributed SQL database on-premises, across clouds or on a laptop. Doing so meant replacing Colossus with a Colossus-like abstraction layer and TrueTime with software-based time synchronization. There is no availability SLA, and practitioners are pricing the move in tail latency and operational toil. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

articles.summary: The AI lab's personal assistant is an operating system from the future designed to compete with Muse, Dots, and Instinct.

articles.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
articles.summary: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.

articles.title: Cloudflare Introduces CLI for AI Agents, Sunsetting Wrangler
articles.summary: Cloudflare recently launched the open beta of cf, a new open-source, agent-focused command-line interface for interacting with Cloudflare services through a unified CLI. Written in TypeScript, it provides structured output and command discovery to make Cloudflare’s APIs easier for both developers and AI agents. By Renato Losio

articles.title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
articles.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.

articles.title: Mirror Particle is building a ‘world model’ of human behavior
articles.summary: Mirror Particle will launch at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield 200 with a world model built from scratch to predict human behavior, arguing that LLM role-play falls short for market research and brand strategy.

articles.title: Flagged by the Machine: How Google Ads Suspended an Open-Source macOS Term as Malicious
articles.summary: Przemyslaw Alexander Kaminski created RACE, a Rust terminal multiplexer on an infinite canvas that detaches child shells into background processes. When he launched an ad campaign, automated scanners suspended his account for malware despite clean notarization and Safe Browsing checks. The flag illustrates operational deadlocks when ad heuristics evaluate POSIX process architectures. By Olimpiu Pop
